question: What power is attributed to the devotee's name as Viśvambhara?
premises: The devotee is addressed as Viśvambhara
This is declared to be his name
The name is the supreme remover of sin
inference: The name Viśvambhara possesses supreme sin-removing power.
plain_english: Indeed, your name, Viśvambhara, is the supreme remover of sin.
